scope: Separate instrumented fresh-service companions at candidate qualifying/first-failing write rungs, plus explicitly labelled reference/challenge companions where native capacity is inconclusive. They do not qualify native latency or replace any native repetition.
prefix_scope: Outcome confirmation to prefix reply release includes committed, void and error outcomes; committed-only ACK distribution unavailable.
phase_window: Before/after product snapshots include warm-up and drain; phase p99 values are histogram upper bounds.
occupancy_window: Estimated measured 20 s, using the historical resource-sampler start + 100 ms launch allowance + 10 s warm-up anchor, as in the CPU ledger.
